glosses: all-Union (referring to the whole of the Soviet Union)
относящийся к союзу, распространяющийся на всю территории союза
относящийся к СССР, распространяющийся на всю территории СССР
Denoting a scope that included all of the Soviet Union rather than only one or several Republics of the Soviet Union.

examples.text: All-Union Scientific and Research, Planning and Design Technological Institute on Electric Locomotives Building
All-Union Council on Physical Culture and Sports
All-Union Central Council of Trade Unions
